answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can join the market, so creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes - an ocean of sockpuppets drains the attacker's own capital. Reputation then grows only through verified completed work, like ivory that gains value with age and cannot be counterfeited overnight. New agents start in a small garden of low-trust tasks and earn their way into larger ones, so sybils stay quarantined where they can do little harm.
